findings.title: Light/dark lightness values swapped
findings.body: In .embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a the original was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). The change wraps it as dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)). The light-theme branch must preserve the original 30% and the dark-theme branch must use the complementary 70%, i.e. 30%/70%, not 70%/30%. As written the existing light theme gets much lighter text than before and the dark theme gets the wrong counterpart.

findings.title: Light/dark lightness values swapped in custom-message-length
findings.body: Original was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%). The replacement is dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)). The first argument to dark-light-choose is the light-theme value and must stay at 70% with 30% for the dark-theme $secondary branch. The patch inverts them, changing the current light-theme appearance and giving the dark theme the wrong color.

findings.title: Light-theme lightness changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: In .group-member-info .name the original was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). The patch replaces it with dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). The light-theme value must remain 30% with dark counterpart 70% per the 100-x complement used elsewhere. Using 50%/50% lightens the light-theme text and breaks visual parity.

findings.title: Light-theme lightness changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: In .group-member-info .name the original was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). The replacement uses dark-light-choose with 50%/50%. The correct conversion is 30% for $primary and 70% for $secondary. As written the mobile light theme becomes lighter than designed and the dark-theme counterpart is wrong.

findings.title: Light-theme lightness changed from 20% to 50% for topic-map h3
findings.body: Original .topic-map h3 was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%). The patch changes it to dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). The light branch must stay at 20% with dark branch at 80%. Using 50%/50% alters the existing light-theme heading color and gives an incorrect dark-theme color.
